name: DISCONFIRMER — momentum-only control (the social-dominance spec with social_dom_z removed)
rationale: Pre-registered SUBSUMPTION disconfirmer for social-dominance-share-leadership-long. IDENTICAL spec MINUS the social_dom_z legs: same long-only, same ~1-week hold, same price-momentum entry (ret_Nd > mom_floor) and the SAME stop/tp/time-stop param ranges. If this momentum-only arm matches or beats the social-dominance arm's deflated Sharpe under the SAME cohort BH-FDR, then social_dom_z adds NO orthogonal information and the 'relative-attention-share' edge is just price momentum (the double-sort that held momentum fixed already collapsed the spread to t~0.2-1.0). A control that reproduces the candidate FALSIFIES it.
catalyst: price momentum alone (no social signal) — the null the attention-share hypothesis must beat
